digest.component_or_area: ADR-0083 documentation and reconciler capability dispatch
propositions: ADR-0083 prescribes isinstance-only capability detection against @runtime_checkable Protocols, which was safe on Python 3.11 but became unsafe on 3.12+ when CPython switched to inspect.getattr_static for Protocol member resolution, causing false negatives on proxying/dynamic attribute transport objects.

On Python 3.12+, isinstance checks against @runtime_checkable Protocols fail for decorator/wrapper/proxy objects that serve members via __getattr__, causing capability-dependent writes to silently skip without indicating the transport has the capability.

The tree-wide sweep under Python 3.12.13 found zero direct isinstance(obj, SupportsX) calls and confirmed the single executable capability dispatch site (dispatch_apply_phases.py:188) is already proxy-hardened with an or hasattr fallback.

ADR-0083 text requires amendment to document that isinstance is necessary but not sufficient on Python 3.12+, cite the getattr_static behaviour change and proxy consequence, and prescribe the isinstance-primary plus member-level hasattr-fallback pattern with _capability_present as reference implementation.
